metrics.usage: Deep-AmPEP30 achieves 77% accuracy on a balanced benchmark dataset of 188 samples.
metrics.evidence: Deep-AmPEP30 yields an improved performance of 77% in accuracy.
85% in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC).
85% in area under the precision-recall curve (AUC-PR).

important_evidence: AMP: source code and datasets at https://github.com/researchprotein/amp, web server at http://amp.denglab.org.
Deep-AmPEP30: web server at https://cbbio.cis.um.edu.mo/AxPEP, 77% accuracy, 85% AUC-ROC, 85% AUC-PR; experimentally validated peptide P3 against Bacillus subtilis and Vibrio parahaemolyticus.

EBAMP: 37.5% of 256 designed sequences bactericidal; top 10 show low cytotoxicity and strong antibacterial effect (2 μg/mL) against multidrug-resistant bacteria and fungi; in vivo mouse wound infection model effective.
DLFea4AMPGen: 75% (12/16) of selected sequences had at least two activities; D1 showed broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity in vitro and in vivo.
uncertainties: Fulltext content for all four papers did not match actual articles; real fulltexts needed to verify code availability, methods, and datasets.
DOIs for several papers may be incorrect; correct DOIs should be verified.
EBAMP and DLFea4AMPGen are de novo design methods, not pure prediction models; suitability for AMP prediction benchmarks needs clarification.
AMP model's dataset details (positive/negative samples, deduplication) require examination of the actual GitHub repository.
